translation.name: Raraŋ Aetaniacna Kam Wembaŋ Laŋ
translation.englishName: New Testament in Mborena Kam language

content: Iesusa ramoot ianna ŋeroŋ ŋgoreaca moa kecariatna
Karica Iesusapa mana iŋa raŋgairena ramtaɨra mina Galili mɨarmo kataca, waŋgembai magat, na anna ma Gerasananta pitrik waŋmbai ndeacrena.
Ri, Iesusa kor tɨkcarica gaca wɨtɨkatke, ŋeroŋ ŋgoreaca mbukca eacrina ramootta muk ndeacrinanna, ma tawi ŋgoin motemma man ndambuŋa ootta kɨprina.
Na an ramootta ma warir mutocrena mukna roumb ndeacrena, na ramoot ianna manmo ŋgatɨk mbuŋa leacna towanaiŋ, co lawirta ŋgatɨk mbuŋa leacna mɨnna wanaiŋ.
Ainda mori, memetmbaca ramtaɨra mana parniŋapa orniŋmo an lawirta ŋgatɨk mbuŋa leacri, na ma anmo ma moa katacrena, na ramoot ianna manmo muoc, iriki mbiracna mɨnna wanaiŋ, ma gargar ŋgoin.
Ainda moca mouŋ, ra, an ramootta an mina ramtaɨrta warir mutocrena mukna roumbapa takur tekerna roumbmo tamtamma ndada taŋrena. Na ma kamb anik keri, na anna watura mana tikmo katacrena.
Na ma wattatnanna Iesusa mon tawan ŋgoin nakɨpri, karica ma ootta taŋga Iesusna outta taŋga, mana outta tɨkca paŋan ramtukca tutupniŋ marɨmbɨtat.

Karica an ramootta kam aniac keca aind mambopat, “Iesus, u Tamuŋ Ŋgoin ndeacrena Raraŋ Aetaniacna Nuoc, u aukmo kaia mona moek? Na aku unmo Raraŋ Aetaniacna i mbuŋa digina mamoek, u aukmo gɨrgɨr ianna kai neaŋ teac!”
Na an ramootta aindopatna mɨnɨŋa gaind, Iesusa an ŋeroŋ ŋgoreacmo mboprina, “U ŋeroŋ ŋgoreac, u an ramootmo tɨkcarica laru!”
Karica Iesusa manmo madigiat, “Una ia mandai?” Ri, ma rutica gaindopatna, “Aukna ia Wɨt, aintik ŋerŋgaur ŋgorik wɨt aniaca aukap eacrena.”
Karica ma Iesusmo aemaŋmaŋap iŋambutta mambopat, ma minmo kai mandaca mina an pitrikmo kai tɨkcarica taŋ teac.
Na markɨmta tumbun aniaca, an takur roumbmo ambca taŋri.
Ri, an ŋerŋgaur ŋgorikca Iesusmo aemaŋmaŋap gaind mambopat, “U aimo mandaca aia mon markɨmbca mbukna, te, aia mina mbukna.”

Karica mina aindopatna mbatca, Iesusa minmo ainda moa mandacatna, mbatca an ŋerŋgaur ŋgorikca, an ramootmo tɨkcarica taŋga an markɨmbmo mbukatke, na an markɨmta tumbunna ŋgaŋganŋgɨa 2,000na mɨn, na mina an takur tamuŋ ŋgetacndiŋa aŋgɨa ootta irikca an pacpɨkɨnna mɨara pukca, puk ambca menaca mamaiat.

Ainda moatke, an markɨmta ŋginaŋa morina ramtaɨra kɨpcamacariat. Na mina taŋga an auŋ aniacapa an pitrikna auŋembta meikramtaɨr muruŋcamiŋmo an reacna kam ndopa, mina kɨpca an laruatna reaca watna moca.
Ri, an meikramtaɨra kɨpca Iesus ndambuŋ ndaruca watri, an ramootta, ŋerŋgaur ŋgorikca mbukca eacrinanna, ma ndona tik ŋgapaoc aoca iro laŋapa mbiraca eacri, na mina ainda watca nanambiatna.

Ainda moca an meikramtaɨr mandaibinna an laruatna reaca wattatnanna, mina taŋga, kabena meikramtaɨr ndeidmo, an ŋerŋgaur ŋgorikca mbukca eacrina ramootna kammo ninia mboprina. Na mina an markɨmta kam motoco ninia mbopatna.
Ainda moatke, an pitrik waŋna meikramtaɨra ŋgepca Iesusmo an pitrik waŋ tɨkcarina moca aemaŋmaŋap mambopri.
Ainda moca maica Iesusa kor naŋgabukna mori, ŋgaua an ŋerŋgaur ŋgorikca mbukca eacrina ramootta Iesusa moa laŋa moatna ramootta, ndomo Iesusap taŋna moca aemaŋmaŋap madigiat.
Ri, Iesusa manmo mba wattacarica ma mba taŋgatke, ma an ramootmo aindopatna, “U ndona kaca nda taŋca ndona wiwitmo mbop warac, titocna reik muruŋa Kacootta unmo kakadmaina opotaca morinan.”
Karica an ramootta ŋgepca taŋga, an pitrik Dekapolisnanmo, ma minmo an kam wembaŋ laŋa Iesusa manmo moa laŋa moatna, ninia mbopca taŋri, na meikramtaɨra muruŋcamiŋa waraca tamtam malamŋiat.
Iesusa menacatna mooŋ ianna wat mac nda neaŋgatke, na meac ianna roumbca moa laŋa moatna
Karica Iesusa kor naŋgabukca, mɨarmo monmbai waŋ nagacat, na ma mɨarna roumb ndeacri, na meikramtaɨrta tumbun ianna manmo mac kɨpca aumb mamoat.
Ri, an Iudananta mimitpac aŋgɨrena kacna ramoot paŋan ianna mana ia Iairus, ma kɨpca anna tɨkca Iesusmo watca ma Iesusna outmo ma tutupniŋ marɨmbɨtat.
Karica ma iŋambut ŋgoinna aemaŋmaŋap mambopri, “Aukna mooŋa ma menacna mamoek. Aintik u kɨpca ndona parmo man nambatta tɨk te, ma ndona wat mac nda aŋgɨca eacna.”
Ri, Iesusa ŋgepca an ramootap mataŋgat. Na meikramtaɨrta tumbun aniaca mana iŋa raŋgaica taŋri, ndorimo mana kɨtɨmma tɨkca aumba moca ratapaca moa mataŋri.
Na an meikramtaɨrta rɨkca meac ianna memetmbaca ma meikpitikta karwaina roumbap, na an roumbca manmo aŋgɨca eaca taŋga iarira parniŋapa mbut mbuniŋna mɨn mbuŋ.

Na an meac, ma an pitir gagamarmo kitukndukar anik puŋga ŋgoikri, na mina an meacmo moi laŋa mo ŋgocor, wanaiŋ ŋgoin, mina manmo gɨgɨrar neaŋrenan, na mana an roumbca mina manmo mba moa laŋa mori, wanaiŋ ŋgoin.
Na meac ianna Iesusna tik ŋgapaoc rocotmo pipikrinaRi, an meaca Iesusa kɨprina kam wembaŋa waraca, ma kɨpca an tumbun aniacna rɨk ndeaca, Iesusna iŋmbaia taŋca mana tik ŋgapaoc rocotmo pipikri,
na ma gaind ndamŋiatna, ma Iesusna tik ŋgapaoca pipik te, mana roumbca laŋa monande.
Ri, ma ainda moatna mbatca mana racainda anduna katacatke, ma ndona tik maraŋgaiat, mana roumbca laŋ mamoat.
Ainda moatke, Iesusa malamŋiat, mana gargara laruca mataŋgat, na ma uriraca minmo, madigiat, “Mandaia ndo aukna tik ŋgapaocmo pipikapekna?”
Ri, mana iŋa raŋgairena ramtaɨra mamo gaind mambopat, “U wat, meikramtaɨr wɨt ŋgoinna unap tɨkca ndada rapacrenan, na u madigiek, mandaia ndo unmo pipikapekna?”
Na Iesusa kocnaia meikramtaɨrmo watta korereri, mandai ŋgoinna ndo manmo pipikrina.
Karica an meac mbitaca ma lamŋiatna, an reaca manmo laruapekna, na ma kɨpca Iesusna out ŋgirikca tutupniŋ rɨmbɨtca nanambia nekca ma Iesusmo kamb gidkara muruŋ mambopat.
Ri, ma an meac mbitacmo gaind mambopat, “Mooŋmbitac, u aukmo rɨpacri, aintik u laŋ mamoat. Na u taŋca una nikinik iro wetwet ndeac. Na una roumbca laŋ mamori.”
Na an mɨnna Iesusa an meacap mbopreke, ramtaɨr ndeida an Iairusna kac ndiŋ nakɨpca mina an ramoot paŋanmo gaind mambopat, “Una mooŋa mamenacri, aintik u ririptimo aiŋ wanaiŋa kai neaŋ teac.”
Ri, Iesusa an ramtaɨr mbopatna kamb mbaraca, ma an Iudananta mimitpac aŋgɨrena kacna ramoot paŋanmo aind mambopat, “U kai nanambi teac, u rɨpac niŋgik.”
Ainda moca ma meikramtaɨrmo manap taŋnarica wandɨk tɨkca ma Pitaapa, Iemisapa mana lapmbitac Ionap, na min mbonkac niŋgikmo aca aŋgɨra mina manap mataŋgat.
Ainda moca mina taŋga an Iudananta mimitpac aŋgɨrena kacna ramoot paŋanna kac ndaruca wattatnanna, meikramtaɨr wɨt aniaca punica gararar anikca mori, aea mboracarica.
Ri, Iesusa an kaca mbukca minmo gaindopatna, “Ne kaina moca gararar anikca moca aerena? An mooŋa, ma mba menacreke, ma maŋgoreke.”

Na mina manmo malaroŋgat. Ainda moatke, Iesusa minmo mbopca mina kacmo tɨkcarica muruŋcamiŋa raekmbai ndaruatke, ma an mooŋnuocna amepaetniŋapa mana iŋa raŋgairena ramtaɨr mbonkacap aŋgɨca, mina an mooŋna waɨr tɨkca eacrina diab mambukat.
Ri, mina mbukca Iesusa an mooŋna par ŋgutiŋga, na gan kam tɨp mambopat, “Talita, koum.” Na an kam tɨpna mɨnɨŋa gaind, “Meac teker u ŋgep!”
Ri, an mooŋa anduna ŋgepca taŋ kɨp tɨkri, na mina anna watca ŋgep ŋgoreac naŋgepca tamtam malamŋiat. Na an mooŋna iarira parniŋapa mbut mbuniŋna mɨn.
Karica Iesus minmo an laruapekna reacna kammo, kabena meikramtaɨrmo mbop narica makɨracat. Ri, ma minmo an mooŋmo amna reac, emtem neaŋca amna mbopatna.
